copper_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.name: Copper Structure Retrieval for Bulk Modulus
copper_structure_retrieval_subtask_bm.description: Retrieve structure of Copper and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

copper_potential_file_subtask_bm.name: Copper Potential File for Bulk Modulus
copper_potential_file_subtask_bm.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Copper for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

copper_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.name: Copper Relaxation for Bulk Modulus
copper_energy_minimisation_subtask_bm.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Copper structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Copper, based on the given simulation parameters. As the final output, return the absolute path of the relaxed structure.

copper_C11_subtask_bm.name: copper Elastic Tensor C11 Calculation
copper_C11_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small finite strain in the ε_1 = ε_xx mode to the relaxed copper structure. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress tensor components from the relaxed configurations. Use the linear stress–strain relationship to compute the elastic stiffness constant C11 of copper in GPa units.

copper_C22_subtask_bm.name: copper Elastic Tensor C22 Calculation
copper_C22_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small finite strain in the ε_2 = ε_yy mode to the relaxed copper structure. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress tensor components from the relaxed configurations. Use the linear stress–strain relationship to compute the elastic stiffness constant C22 of copper in GPa units.

copper_C33_subtask_bm.name: copper Elastic Tensor C33 Calculation
copper_C33_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small finite strain in the ε_3 = ε_zz mode to the relaxed copper structure. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress tensor components from the relaxed configurations. Use the linear stress–strain relationship to compute the elastic stiffness constant C33 of copper in GPa units.

copper_C44_subtask_bm.name: copper Elastic Tensor C44 Calculation
copper_C44_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small finite strain in the ε_4 = 2ε_yz mode to the relaxed copper structure. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress tensor components from the relaxed configurations. Use the linear stress–strain relationship to compute the elastic stiffness constant C44 of copper in GPa units.

copper_C55_subtask_bm.name: copper Elastic Tensor C55 Calculation
copper_C55_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small finite strain in the ε_5 = 2ε_xz mode to the relaxed copper structure. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress tensor components from the relaxed configurations. Use the linear stress–strain relationship to compute the elastic stiffness constant C55 of copper in GPa units.

copper_C66_subtask_bm.name: copper Elastic Tensor C66 Calculation
copper_C66_subtask_bm.description: Apply a small finite strain in the ε_6 = 2ε_xy mode to the relaxed copper structure. After applying each strain, perform structure relaxation. Extract the corresponding stress tensor components from the relaxed configurations. Use the linear stress–strain relationship to compute the elastic stiffness constant C66 of copper in GPa units.

copper_bulk_modulus_subtask_bm.name: copper Bulk Modulus Calculation via Voigt Approximation
copper_bulk_modulus_subtask_bm.description: Using the previously computed elastic stiffness constants (C11, C22, C33, C44, C55, C66), compute the bulk modulus of copper employing the Voigt averaging method. Return the bulk modulus value in GPa units.
